claims.text: First-line for uncomplicated cystitis in women without risk factors for a multidrug-resistant gram-negative organism: 100 mg orally twice a day for 5 days.
claims.quote: First-line treatment of uncomplicated cystitis in women who do not have risk factors for a multidrug-resistant gram-negative organism is nitrofurantoin 100 mg orally twice a day for 5 days

claims.text: Contraindicated if creatinine clearance is < 60 mL/min.
claims.quote: it is contraindicated if creatinine clearance is < 60 mL/min

claims.text: Not recommended for men: poor tissue penetration, and not effective when the prostate may be involved.
claims.quote: nitrofurantoin is not recommended for men because of poor tissue penetration and lack of efficacy in case there is potential prostatic involvement
